title: ParsedPart has no tree-walk API (no find_by_id, no iter_parts)
description: ParsedPart exposes .children: Vec<ParsedPart> but no method to find a part by ID. The README example calls find_by_id() which doesn't exist. Callers needing to access a part by ID must implement recursive tree walking themselves. This is a leaky abstraction — the crate defines the tree structure but forces callers to re-implement traversal. Fix: add 'fn find_by_id(&self, id: &str) -> Option<&ParsedPart>' to ParsedPart, or add an Iterator that yields (part_id, part_ref) pairs.
